'''Starglasses''' were a type of eyewear. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Mazer Rackus]] wore starglasses.
